```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r data}
tmp <- read_excel("data/ncesdata_MASS_202425.xlsx", skip = 9, col_names = FALSE)

header <- unlist(tmp[3, ], use.names = FALSE)
school_data <- tmp[-c(1, 2, 3), ]
colnames(school_data) <- header

school_data <- school_data %>%
  mutate(
    Locale = as.factor(Locale),
    Students = as.numeric(Students)
  )
```

## Column {data-width=320}

### About

This dashboard presents two univariate visualizations using Massachusetts school data.

The categorical plot shows the distribution of schools by locale.

The numerical plot shows the distribution of student enrollment.

## Column

### Categorical variable: Locale

```{r cat-plot}
cat_data <- school_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Locale), Locale != "") %>%
  count(Locale, name = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent = Count / sum(Count) * 100,
    Label = paste0(round(Percent, 1), "%"),
    Locale = forcats::fct_reorder(Locale, Percent)
  )

ggplot(cat_data, aes(x = Locale, y = Percent)) +
  geom_col(fill = "gray65", width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Label), hjust = -0.1, size = 5) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Schools by Locale",
    subtitle = "Massachusetts school data",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percent"
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(cat_data$Percent) + 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

### Numerical variable: Students

```{r}
ggplot(school_data, aes(x = Students)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "gray30", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Student Enrollment",
    subtitle = "Massachusetts school data",
    x = "Number of students",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
